description: A failure that does not fit the window's retention budget (here 16 bytes) keeps the domain-failed status, because the command did fail as declared, but omits failure and adds delivery. outcome() rejects with BridgeError("failed") carrying the delivery message.

delivery.message: The operation failed as declared, but its failure exceeds the 16 byte retention limit.

error.message: The operation failed as declared, but its failure exceeds the 16 byte retention limit.
